name: zw-income-tax
description: Zimbabwe income tax for individuals and the self-employed, tax year 2026: PAYE bands in USD and ZWG, the 3% AIDS levy, the flat 25% on trade and investment income, quarterly payment dates, the ITF12C return, the move of professionals and larger transporters to self-assessment, presumptive rental income tax and the 50:50 currency rule. Use for questions such as how much PAYE do I pay, ZIMRA tax table, QPD dates, freelancer tax in Zimbabwe, or rental income tax in Zimbabwe. Companies are in zw-corporate-income-tax and employer payroll in zw-payroll-social.
